name: Desiccation Pulse (CR 11)
body:
Desiccation Pulse
CR 11

XP 12,800

Source: Pathfinder #12

Type magic (conjuration and necromancy); Perception DC 33 Disable Device DC 33

EFFECTS

Trigger proximity (any light source); Onset Delay 2 rounds; Reset automatic (after 2 minutes)

Effect spell effect (horrid wilting, CL 18th, Fortitude DC 26 half, if using in AP12, affects all creatures in area A8) and summons four bodaks (the summoned bodaks vanish in 18 rounds as the trap resets)
